newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NAB says margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NAB says margins under pressure.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Thursday its margins were under pressure.
Asked by reporters if margins in the current quarter were under pressure, managing director Don Argus replied: "Yes".
Major banks have been facing sharp competition from non-bank lenders in the lucrative home lending market over the past year, forcing them to reduce mortgage rates.
National Australia Bank earlier reported a 6.8 percent rise in net profit to A$2.1 billion for the year to September 30.
